# Kreative Minds

> Kreative Minds is a Dubai-based digital agency building tech tools, brands, and campaigns that move businesses forward. From strategy to execution, one team handles product development, marketing, and growth for clients worldwide.

## About

Kreative Minds (legal name: KM Marketing and PR, Dubai Mainland License No. 1377759) operates as a multidisciplinary team led by founder Khalid Hussain Mir (alias Khalidgraphy). The company combines strategy, software development, brand, and marketing under one roof.

Headquarters: Jumeirah Beach Residence, Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
Founded: 2024.
Working with clients across the UAE, GCC, UK, Europe, and beyond.

## Tagline

Building systems that work on the ground. We don't do theories that sound good, we build what actually works. Instead of hype, we deliver results.

## Services

1. Strategy and Validation — market research, positioning, pricing, go-to-market planning.
2. Product and SaaS Development — custom software, micro SaaS, internal tools, AI workflows, on Cloudflare Workers, D1, React.
3. AI and Automation — Claude AI integrations, workflow automation, internal copilots, WhatsApp Cloud API.
4. Brand Strategy and Identity — positioning, naming, visual identity, design systems.
5. Performance Marketing — Meta, Google, LinkedIn, TikTok paid acquisition, landing pages, retention.
6. SEO and Content — technical SEO, content strategy, AEO and structured data for AI engines.
7. Public Relations and Media — brand narrative, press outreach, founder thought leadership.
8. Social Media Strategy — channel strategy, content production, creator partnerships.
9. eCommerce Strategy — Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon, Noon UAE.
10. Business Setup — UAE Mainland, UAE Free Zone, USA LLC, USA INC, UK Ltd company formation.

## Live products

- InvoiceDubai (https://invoicedubai.com) — VAT-ready invoicing platform for UAE businesses.
- MyKard (https://mykard.link) — Digital business cards with WhatsApp lead capture and AI assist.
